SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

SHANGHAI: 30-7-1930.
1 - 8 - 30.

Sir,

I wish to acknowledge the receipt
of your letter of the 29th instant,
No. S.B. D. 1479 regarding R.E.H.K.
BÖCKMANN, and to thank you for the in-
formation contained therein.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Chinese Secretary.

J.P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer in charge of Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

ate 29 - 7 - 30.

July 29, 30.

Sir,

With reference to your letter,
No. 2270, dated July 24, 1930, I have to
inform you that there is nothing in Police
records against Richard Ernst Hans Karl
BOCKMANN, who has applied to your Consulate
for a visa to proceed to Samarinda, Borneo.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your Obedient Servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch
for Deputy Commissioner
(Crime & Special Branches)

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 1270

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. D. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 1479
Date 25 - 7 - 30.
1930

SHANGHAI, 24th July 1930

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Richard Ernst Hans
Karl BÖCKMANN, of German nationality, born at Kiel 16 December
1900, at present domiciled at the Stadium, where he is em-
ployed as an engineer, desires to proceed to Samarinda (Borneo
in order to execute work there at the saw mills of the Langkat
Company, represented at Shanghai by George McBain.

He is called there at the suggestion of Mr. Gray, a
British subject, who was also employed at the Stadium and is
at present in Samarinda.

It appears that Böckmann arrived in Shanghai about 6
years ago and was formerly employed at the Shanghai Portland
Cement Works at Lunghua.

During 1927 he resided at 156 Seymour Road and in 1928
at 2 Temple Lane.

I would be much obliged to know whether anything is known
against this person from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
Chinese Secretary.

R.C.Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

第 1270 号

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号 S. B. D. 1479
日期 25 - 7 - 30。
1930年

上海，1930年7月24日

先生：

谨此告知，Richard Ernst Hans
Karl BÖCKMANN，德国籍，1900年12月16日
生于基尔（Kiel），现寓居体育场（Stadium），受雇
担任工程师，拟前往婆罗洲萨马林达（Samarinda），
以便在那里为 Langkat 公司的锯木厂工作，该公司
在上海由 George McBain 代表。

他是应 Gray 先生的建议被召往该处的，Gray 先生
系英国臣民，也曾受雇于体育场，目前
在萨马林达。

据悉，Böckmann 约于6年前抵达上海，此前
曾受雇于龙华的上海波特兰水泥厂（Shanghai Portland
Cement Works）。

1927年间，他居住在西摩路（Seymour Road）156号，1928年
居住在庙街（Temple Lane）2号。

若蒙告知从政治或道德角度是否掌握
对此人不利的情况，本人将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，
[签名]
华务秘书。

致：
R.C. Aiers 先生，
警务处副总监，
刑事及特别股，
上海。
